failure: ODT exports preserved whitespace in headers footers and frame text: expected ["  Frame\tend "] but returned [""]. Original assertion retained unchanged.
cause: The incoming section-owning text:p wrapper contains draw:frame/draw:text-box paragraphs. The streaming extractor consumes the outer paragraph subtree, while its inline-only decoder omits draw namespace children; bounded search shared the same loss path.
fix: Discover nearest owned draw:text-box roots using namespace identity, without descending into notes, annotations, covered cells, foreign inline markup or ruby annotations.

Keep parent inline text as one paragraph before its frame stories. Omit an empty anchor only if actual textbox paragraph blocks replace it; retain ordinary blank paragraphs, empty frames and explicit whitespace.
Decode each frame paragraph once with the same cumulative UTF-8 budget. Search and cell text account for each inserted paragraph separator.
Use a local block walker for consumed paragraph subtrees so frame tables retain rows/cells rather than appearing as body paragraphs. Do not revisit a table-cell subtree after decoding it.
Skip note stories consistently in structured traversal and namespace-less search fallback.
regression_coverage: section-owning frame whitespace and separate/blank paragraphs
parent inline text plus multiple/nested frame stories without duplicates
frame-contained tables and frames inside cells
hidden annotation/note/covered-cell/ruby stories with huge and malformed text:s counts
drawing namespace aliases and foreign lookalikes
ordinary blanks, empty frames, image anchors and explicit whitespace
negative and excessive visible text:s validation
exact cumulative UTF-8 and paragraph-separator limits
